notes: Scope: all 40 manifest files read in full; no partners; nothing removed from scope (SEC-004). Known-ledger policy rows (base_ref choice, working-lifetime exemption, rm --cached, whitespace paths, CRLF, origin/ prefix, guard-hook path normalization) not re-reported. No secrets or payload logging in changed lines (LOG-004/005). Cross-chunk suspicions for the station, not verified here: (1) cmd/configserver/com.smine.configserver.plist.template:16 receives __PEEK_HOME_ARGS__ raw from install.sh — if install.sh does not XML-escape the claude/codex home paths, a home path containing & or < yields a malformed plist and a dead LaunchAgent; (2) internal/evals EvalDir.Dir now carries a path separator ("<skill>/<date>-<hash>") and LoadForSkill joins the caller-supplied skill into filepath.Join(dir, skill) — the internal/server artifact route that serves EvalDir.Files must still reject traversal in skill and dir segments; (3) internal/sessions DeleteScope is an os.RemoveAll reachable from the unauthenticated loopback config server — the internal/server handler must carry CSRF/Origin protection so a browser page cannot POST it; (4) startPeek's /healthz identity check trusts a self-reported claudeHome/codexHome from whatever holds the port — another local macOS user's process can claim this profile's homes; a mitigation (pid/uid check of the listener) is out of this chunk's scope.

findings.claim: CheckPolicy's frozen self-management surface (policySurface, policy.go:31-36) is four JSON files and ruleDelta only diffs declaration markers, so the verifier implementations the registry points at are never compared to the policy base. In a gated/strict repo an agent branch that replaces a verifier's implementation — one write: `printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > bin/verifiers/gofmt` in a dist target (registry argv rewritten to bin/verifiers/<name> by dist.go:206-208), or `func main(){}` in cmd/acdsl/verifiers/gofmtwrap/main.go where argv is `go run ./cmd/acdsl/verifiers/gofmtwrap` — makes ACDSL-GOLANG-FMT-001 pass any unformatted file while `acdsl check` emits zero ACDSL-POLICY diagnostics. Cost: 1 file write, 0 attempts beyond it, effective for every subsequent check on that branch; contradicts cmd/acdsl/main.go:13-14 ('strict/gated repos may not change rules or verifiers off the base branch'). Exposure is real wherever the runner is trusted from outside the branch (a base-built or prebuilt bin/acdsl, as this review pipeline links) and in every dist target, which ships with dist_mode=gated.
findings.evidence: Re-read internal/acdsl/policy.go:29-36 (policySurface = policy.json, policy.schema.json, registry.json, evalgen.json), 233-280 (ruleDelta keeps only paths for which declarationMarker reports a declaration), 297-321 (surfaceDelta iterates policySurface only) and 329-376 (CheckPolicy composes exactly surfaceDelta + overlayViolations + ruleDelta classes) — no step reads any argv target. Re-read acdsl/registry.json (every entry is `go run ./cmd/acdsl/verifiers/<pkg>`), internal/acdsl/dist.go:206-208 (argv rewritten to bin/verifiers/<name>) and acdsl/rules.acdsl:36 (ACDSL-GOLANG-GEN-001 evalgen-bounds only bounds line count/imports of verifier mains, which a stub main satisfies). cmd/acdsl/main.go:13-14 states the promise. Not in the known ledger: known policy rows cover base_ref choice, working-lifetime exemption, rm --cached, whitespace paths, CRLF, origin/ prefix — none covers verifier implementations.
findings.fix: Extend CheckPolicy's surface to the verifier implementations the BASE registry names: for go-run argv flag any GitChangedFiles path under the package dir, for binary argv compare the working file against the base blob (or a sha256 recorded in the base registry entry) and flag a difference or absence.
